programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set "within the architecture of the mind." Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: Jack The Giant Slayer

When a young farmhand unwittingly opens a gateway between our world and a fearsome race of giants, an ancient war is reignited. Unleashed upon the Earth, the marauding giants strive to reclaim the land they once lost, forcing Jack into the battle of his life to stop them. Fighting for a kingdom and its people -- and the love of a princess, of course -- he comes face to face with the legendary goliaths and, in the process, become a legend himself.

programme.desc: The elves build a rocket. King Thistle, Holly, Nanny Plum, Ben, Mr Elf and Gaston fly it into space to have a picnic on the moon. // Thistle and the gang meet some friendly aliens, but then they realise they do not have enough fuel to return home.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.210: Friends / Star Hunt / Spin
programme.desc: Tim & Kai have a rare disagreement, and each try to find a new best friend. // Tim & Kai compete in a Star Hunt through Rumbleton. // When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.301: The Crew Builds A Vet Clinic / The Crew Builds A Mermaid Party
programme.desc: When the traveling veterinarian Dr. Diwa can't finish all her checkups in Builder Cove in time, Rubble & Crew know just what to do. // Lily's mermaid-themed birthday party is called off when it starts to rain. Time for a construction solution!

programme.desc: Santiago and crew must retrieve a powerful undersea artifact after it's stolen by Enrique. // Bonnie Bones transforms into a baby and it's up to the good pirates to change her back.

programme.title: DORA S1 Ep.109: Tres Leches Trouble / Wizzle Wozzle Woo
programme.desc: Dora, Boots, and Benny have to trek through the rainforest to deliver a big, delicate tres leches cake to Benny's abuela. // Dora and the Fiesta Trio investigate a loud, strange noise that caused them to lose their instruments.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S2 Ep.209: Darington to the Moon!
programme.desc: Today Darington will attempt his biggest stunt yet: rocketing to the moon! But his battery-powered rocket is out of energy. To get to the moon, Blaze must help Darington recharge his battery with all the energy they can find.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.105: Tiny Croc / Camping Croc
programme.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile find a tiny lizard who wants to be just like Mr. Crocodile. // Winston tries to be the leader on a nature hike, but his high-tech gadget gets everyone lost in the woods.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.213: Watch Out For Barbabright / If I Were A Billionaire

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.105: Moon Cow / Nebulator / Space Bug
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy & Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner. // Kai is super excited to ride the Nebulator, but Tim isn't so sure. // Tim and Kai try to photograph the illusive SpaceBug.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.206: The Crew Builds A Gym / The Crew Puts On A Construction Show
programme.desc: Coach Karima asks Rubble & Crew to build a gym for the gymnastics show. But when the beam is too high for Lily, it's up to the pups to save the day.//When a traveling show can't get to Builder Cove, Rubble & Crew decides to build a show of their own!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S8 Ep.811: Pups vs. A Neon Humdinger / Pups Save A Royal Painting
programme.desc: When Mayor Humdinger's giant neon sign of himself gets loose, the Paw Patrol must stop it from rolling through town. // Sweetie steals a painting of the Princess and attempts to replace it with one of herself.

programme.desc: Baron Bite steals Jade's Invisibility Crystal and makes everything he dislikes disappear! // The Deer Squad take the twins on a space adventure, but they end up sinking into a jelly planet.

programme.title: DORA S2 Ep.203: Isa's Royal Garden Party / Sammy's Surprise
programme.desc: The Queen of Reptiles is visiting Isa, but the garden's a mess! Dora helps her get everything ready in time for La Reina's visit. / Dora meets Sammy the Sloth, who needs to get to Day Camp on time so he can show everyone a special surprise.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.102: Lorelai's Bracelet / Cecelia And The Ghost Ship
programme.desc: Bonnie steals Lorelai's bracelet, turning herself into a mermaid and while trapping Lorelai in human form! // Santi and crew must overcome ghostly shenanigans to save Cecilia from the dreaded Ghost Ship

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.207: Don't Go Grandma

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.225: Living Together / Holey The Snowman

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.226: The Mountain Eater / The First Day Of School

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S7 Ep.726: School Bus Blaze!

programme.title: Drazilion Ep.4: Exploring Virmark
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: Passe-Moi Les Jumelles Ep.7: The Soul and the Sword / Olga, Shaman of the Peaks
programme.desc: A portrait of a passionate fencing master and a tribute to Olga Letykai Csonka, the shaman who passed away in 2024.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Les Secrets Du Finistère
programme.desc: Having returned to her native Brittany, Police Captain Morgane Ledantec is faced with the discovery of human bones after a sacred oak tree is felled by a storm. The victim was a Druid. Morgane needs to renew her contacts with childhood friends, who all seem to have something to hide.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi Ep.30: Craft special
programme.desc: Hélène Morbu, Marie-Amélie and Marie-Caroline Guillot, Annelise Michelson share one thing in common: ceramics. When the hand knows nothing but music: being a creator of notes. Meeting the leatherworkers: Valentine Huyghues Despointes and the craftsmen and women of Atelier Tassin. Milliners, cabinetmakers, fan-makers: Anthony Peto, Alain Taral, the Duvelleroy company.

programme.title: La Nuit Des Rois
programme.desc: In a prison in Abidjan, inmates have established their own rules. If their leader becomes too weak, he must commit suicide. Blackbeard, ill, wants to escape this grim fate. He then invokes an ancient ritual to overturn the established order.

programme.title: Ativio - Les Morceaux De Bois
programme.desc: Guénolé, aged 12, lives in an isolated Togolese village. Gifted in music, he dreams of playing the piano but doesn't own one.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
